writing_rules: Load this template before creating or structurally editing a named special-mission team.
Members are persistent exact named people and must already exist; the team does not duplicate or own their bodies, equipment, capabilities, or source history.
Commander and deputy must be members of the same saved roster.
Role keys may name only saved roster members.
A special-mission team requires lawful institutional assignment and the registered special_mission_cell team type.
Do not add an unregistered field. A new field requires maintenance-time template/schema revision first.
Indexes/caches are rebuilt from authority and never used to bless new authoritative fields.
